fields: lastVerifiedCheckpoint (ciphertext envelope hash and sequence only)
status.readiness: Ready = authorized bootstrap and current data and (rollout disabled or rollout ready); DataCurrent false on failed latest attempt even if old Secret exists; RolloutReady independent

authorization.defaultWriters: trusted namespace administrators or trusted GitOps only; application service accounts read target Secrets only
authorization.binding: admin Store binds exact SekvyrSecret name, binding UUID, source, selection, target and allowed Deployment names
authorization.delegation: untrusted self-service CR creation is excluded; RBAC cannot constrain all fields or create by resourceName
authorization.storeRef: name + immutable UID; recreating the Store requires administrative reauthorization
authorization.installation: one namespace, service account, panel identity and node private key per trust domain
authorization.protectedTargets: all identity/trust/state Secret names and UIDs, service-account token and Helm release namespaces/prefixes; cross-namespace references forbidden
authorization.uniqueness: binding ids/names/resourceNames must be unique per Store; one active binding for a CR and target name across all Stores in the namespace; conflicts fail before any external side effect. uniqueItems on whole objects is not sufficient.

installation.allowedPanelOrigins: admin installation allowlist; Store cannot introduce a new origin
installation.serviceAccount: fixed by installation; no serviceAccountRef, impersonation or arbitrary TokenRequest
installation.identityKeySecret: admin-prepared immutable Secret, mounted read-only; no runtime key generation
installation.trustBundleSecret: admin-prepared immutable Secret, mounted read-only, independent from runtime state
installation.stateSecret: precreated operator-only Secret with recorded UID; loss/replacement is fail-closed
installation.bootstrapGeneration: monotonic administrative authorization generation; never reconstructed from panel or labels
installation.caTrust: caConfigMapRef is admin-only, immutable reference; trust bundle pins ConfigMap UID,key and SHA256 of certificate DER set. Changed CA content requires explicit new administrative authorization. App-writable CA is forbidden; custom CA replaces system roots for that Store.
installation.generationLimit: if witness keys plus ALL canonical journal/independent checkpoints are compromised or rolled back together, protocol cannot detect the lost history. No infinite witness chain or absolute all-roots-rollback promise.
installation.allowedWitnessOrigins: independent administrative allowlist and pinned witness trust, separate from panel origin
installation.externalLedger: witness canonical append-only journal outside panel/operator restore domain; no fresh head signed from stale cache

e2e.securityDecision: D1 selected E2E2 by user: no e2e1 fallback for operator E2E bindings
e2e.readKeys: separate random read key per publishable view and epoch; local target selection is not a confidentiality boundary
e2e.publishKeys: independent Ed25519 private authority, never issued to readers; separate read/publish bundle passwords
e2e.freshness: independent witness nonce proof with canonical floor + durable local checkpoint; current at last linearizable check, not forever latest
e2e.wholeSnapshot: one signed AES-GCM envelope of complete ordered values; immutable realm/project/environment/view/log UUIDs bound in AAD and signature
e2e.bootstrap: out-of-band publisher public key/policy, witness key/epoch/log, min checkpoint, node key and source UUIDs; no TOFU
e2e.limitations: trusted independently distributed writer client required; malicious JavaScript from a compromised panel can use unlocked keys; if witness keys plus ALL canonical journal/independent checkpoints are compromised or rolled back together, protocol cannot detect the lost history. No infinite witness chain or absolute all-roots-rollback promise.; does not erase values already in app memory/env and cannot prevent an admin/etcd restore from exposing an older existing Kubernetes Secret before reconciliation. Strong startup freshness needs separate admission/app gate; not promised here.

rotation.migration: trusted client verifies explicit v1 source baseline, decrypts current approved values, creates new view key/publisher authority, signs initial e2e2 full view, commits to witness, installs independent trust bundle, then atomically switches mode. v1 history not authenticated retroactively.
rotation.legacy: existing e2e1 projects/agents keep old explicit mode; e2e2 readers reject e2e1/plaintext. Old agents receive UpgradeRequired for e2e2, never downgraded values.
rotation.writerRotation: independent authority authorizes new signing policy, stages new-signed snapshot+reader wrappers, atomically activates policy+head at witness, updates trust bundle. Old key cannot sign future canonical commits.
rotation.readRotation: new independent view read key, epoch+1, full new ciphertext, new wrappers for retained readers; commit new sequence; no header-only epoch bump.
rotation.recovery: no panel-initiated epoch/reset. Unrecoverable history requires explicit independently authorized new log/trust epoch, audited migration, consumers stopped until new trust installed.

e2e.migration: trusted client verifies explicit v1 source baseline, decrypts current approved values, creates new view key/publisher authority, signs initial e2e2 full view, commits to witness, installs independent trust bundle, then atomically switches mode. v1 history not authenticated retroactively.
e2e.witnessAuthority: canonical journal includes root log registration/genesis and ALL authority transitions: publisher keysets and policy activations/revocations, read-key epochs, witness key/epoch transitions and administrative recovery. Authorization state is derived from verified journal, never restored cache/config alone.

order: validate installation bootstrap, Store UID, binding, node key, protected target and ownership state
acquire namespaced Lease; leader only writes/reports
obtain first independent nonce+floor witness proof for E2E2
authenticate to panel and fetch exact witness-canonical envelope hash and signed reader key wrapper
verify bounds, canonicalization, publisher signature, source UUIDs, epochs, wrapper and complete decrypted snapshot
verify second nonce+floor witness head; bounded retry if advanced
persist accepted high-watermark durably BEFORE target mutation
select deterministic target bytes; compare existing target
atomically write changed data, opaque revision, accepted checkpoint and eligible rollout intent
converge rollout only under mode-specific freshness gate; status distinguishes failures
reconcile.ownership: registry binds CR UID + Store UID + binding ID + target UID; labels alone never authorize takeover
reconcile.ambiguousCreate: crash between creating target and recording target UID -> StateAmbiguous and explicit admin recovery; no blind adoption
reconcile.retention: Retain default; no ownerReference when Retain; Delete ownerReference only to same-namespace exact CR UID
reconcile.sourceDeletion: e2e2 deletion must be in a full signed witness-committed snapshot; unsigned filtering/404 is never a deletion command. All/Keys selection semantics remain after full verification.
reconcile.paths: canonical absolute POSIX paths; no dot/dotdot, repeated slash, trailing slash except root, backslash or control characters; segment-aware prefix; duplicate source tuples and target keys are errors
reconcile.mutability: Store UID refs,binding IDs,stable view identity,target names/type/deletionPolicy and encryption mode immutable; E2E2 human routing labels may be renamed only administratively while pinned UUIDs remain unchanged. Source selection/rollout allowlist admin-controlled.
reconcile.deletion: no Secret recreation during CR deletion; finalization never waits for panel; Retain preserves identity/trust/state keys outside Helm workload lifecycle
reconcile.partialFailure: no partial Secret content, no false DataCurrent, no new rollout from failed reconcile
reconcile.suspension: suspend=true stops fetch/report, Secret writes and rollout; preserves target; deletion and Store absence never trigger a new restart
reconcile.storeRemoval: missing/deleted/recreated Store UID preserves last target and fails authorization; Delete applies to CR deletion, not Store disappearance
reconcile.namespaceRemoval: Retain does not survive namespace deletion; restore requires external backup and administrative reauthorization
reconcile.retentionPolicy: deletionPolicy is immutable for a binding; conversion needs explicit migration, never a silent ownerReference change during deletion
reconcile.crossResourceValidation: check unique binding fields, source/target conflicts, CA trust pins, protected names/UIDs and immutable references at runtime before report/fetch/target mutation; schema shape alone never establishes authorization.
reconcile.apiCompatibility: Plain may use1.0.3 data plane. E2E2 needs a new explicit panel/API capability and SDK/agent release; 1.0.3 is not E2E2-capable.

rollout.scope: exact same-namespace Deployment names in both CR request and Store allowlist; Deployment must use target Secret
rollout.permissions: chart gives Deployment patch only when rollout installation feature is enabled; RBAC resourceNames allowlist
rollout.initialCreate: no automatic rollout on initial Secret create
rollout.revision: cryptographically random opaque 128-bit ID saved atomically with Secret data; no plaintext hash exposed
rollout.convergence: Plain may resume previously eligible intent on temporary panel outage as specified. E2E2 resumes only after strict canonical-head/snapshot validation; suspend/revoke/delete stop both.
rollout.writes: only own Pod-template annotation; preserve strategy, images, replicas, commands; no Pod delete/scale
rollout.blocked: paused Deployment, missing target, changed UID during patch, denied permissions and progress timeout get independent RolloutReady condition
rollout.intent: data update atomically persists revision plus eligible=false for initial create/disabled; eligible=true only for an authorized update. Intent includes CR UID,Store UID,binding ID,bootstrap generation,Store/CR generations and exact Deployment targets. A missing marker alone never creates eligibility.
rollout.e2e2CurrentGate: E2E2 pending intent also needs successful strict-current reconciliation; new panel/witness failure freezes pending restarts. Ordinary Plain mode retains its separately specified behavior.

toolchain.compiler: Go 1.27.3 pinned current project baseline; recheck security updates at stage 2
toolchain.sdkGoDirective: SDK extraction not shipped; stage3 code uses operator Go1.26 APIs. Older Go compatibility is not claimed; existing agent module remains unchanged.
toolchain.support: targets only; claim compatibility after live stage 7 tests

layout.sdk: sdk/go (own module: github.com/mihsergeev/Sekvyr/sdk/go; e2e and machine packages)
layout.agent: existing agent module consumes sdk via local replace
layout.build: GOWORK=off in reproducible builds; explicit local replace ../sdk/go; root repo Docker contexts; update all three agent build paths and signed manifest together
layout.witness: witness: new Go module plus external canonical ledger adapter; no secrets or read keys stored
layout.writer: independently trusted writer client/bundle, not JavaScript from a potentially compromised panel

validation.unknownFields: strict design validator and fieldValidation=Strict reject; Kubernetes non-strict clients may warn/prune unknown fields. Unknown fields are never preserved or acted upon.

validation.metadata: namespace is DNS1123 label <=63; names are DNS1123 subdomains <=253; semantic binding/target validation is controller responsibility

stage3.scope: restricted JCS codec, signed whole-view envelopes, P256 signed reader wraps, explicit publisher crypto functions, pinned witness proofs and double-head Reader flow with independent bootstrap parsing
stage3.binding: reader bootstrap independently binds installationID,namespace,ServiceAccount,generation,panel origin,node fingerprint,StoreUID,bindingID,view/log UUIDs,publisher/witness public keys and min checkpoint
stage3.checkpoints: local Head must be trusted durable state bound to installation/bootstrap/trust identity. Current signed proof never comes from a bare caller-supplied Head. Missing/replaced state cannot become a new bootstrap automatically.
stage3.integration: standalone in-process verification and tests only; existing controller remains fail-closed until stage4 APIs and persistence are implemented
stage3.releaseStatus: no commit, public release, deployment or migration performed

stage2.historicalScope: records stage2 completion; stage3 fields describe the newly implemented crypto modules
stage2.scope: compileable namespace-scoped controller, structural CRDs with CEL rules, Helm packaging, administrative bootstrap metadata validation and isolated projected-token authentication client
stage2.safetyGate: no source fetch, machine report, target Secret mutation, checkpoint mutation or workload restart in the scaffold; Ready and DataCurrent remain false
stage2.rbac: read exact bootstrap Secret names without Secret list/watch; namespace-only custom-resource/status permissions and precreated Lease; no Secret create/update/patch/delete, Deployment patch, TokenRequest or impersonation
stage2.authentication: fixed pod-bound projected ServiceAccount JWT, dedicated panel audience, read on each login; TLS and origin allowlist; no redirects or environment proxy; short-lived machine session held only in memory. Local unverified claim checks are hygiene only; panel verifies signature/issuer/audience/expiry against configured cluster JWKS.
notYetImplemented: witness transport, proof verification and durable external ledger adapter
cryptographic trust-bundle parsing and node-key validation
durable ownership registry, accepted checkpoint persistence and Secret synchronization
optional workload restart and application data E2E acceptance
stage2.processReadiness: HTTP /healthz and /readyz are process probes only; synchronization readiness is expressed by custom-resource conditions
stage2.releaseStatus: development scaffold only; chart version is not a signed or published product release

roadmapRevision2: stage2: scaffold operator, strict CRD types and witness/ledger interface only after review
stage3: implement E2E2 codec+trusted publisher workflow+signed wrappers, isolate E2E1
stage4: panel immutable snapshots, explicit views, atomic witness-anchored commits, operator checkpoint/Secret
stage5: rollout linked to accepted verified checkpoint
stage6: ledger restore, all authority transitions, HA/key rotations and unavailable witness
stage7: actual backend/storage adapters, cross-language parity and live Kubernetes acceptance
stage8: independent security review, migration/compatibility, signed/versioned releases and controlled rollout
